It was great to see Gabby Collison back in the team and running away from good class opposition in the 3000m to score a notable win while Judy Oakley made it a double for the Belles by taking 'B' race as well.
17 Crawley Club Champs. 5000m: 1, G.Collison 16:52.1; J.Oakley 19:01.4. 20 Tooting, HHH Open Meet. 200m: D.Akinbogun 23.5. 400m: 1, D.Akinbogun 52.2.

Judy Oakley placed second and not surprisingly also carried off the prize for fastest woman. Fastest man overall was 43 year-old Jim Estall, looking for a sharpener to celebrate his recent selection for the England Veterans' Cross-Country.
In coming home 8½ minutes clear of Judy Oakley, she reduced the course record by 48 seconds and took over a minute off her own Club Record which has stood since 1996.
